programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Doktoren og Rose opdager Time Lords farligste fjende nedenfor Utah.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Doktoren udforsker en underlig satellit, og Adams evner som assistent kommer på prøve.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Rose er vidne til den dag, hendes far døde, men indblanding fører forfærdelige konsekvenser med sig.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: I krigstidens London bliver hjemløse børn terroriseret af et overnaturligt barn.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Børnepest spreder sig i krigstidens London.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: En plan om at bygge at atomkraftværk i Cardiff skjuler et komplot blandt rumvæsener.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trouble with Templeton
programme.desc: A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Most Unusual Camera
programme.desc: When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Night of the Meek
programme.desc: After a derelict Santa Claus is fired on Christmas Eve, he finds a mysterious bag that gives out presents. With this bag, he sets out to fulfill his one wish - to see the less fortunate inherit the bounties of Christmas.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dust
programme.desc: In a tragic, western town, a desperate father begs for clemency as his son is slated to die for an accident he could not have prevented.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Back There
programme.desc: At a prominent club in Washington, D.C., a socialite argues about whether it would be possible to change history by traveling back in time. When he leaves the club he finds himself in 1865, on the night that President Lincoln will be shot.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Whole Truth
programme.desc: A used car salesman buys a car that dooms him to tell only the truth.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Invaders
programme.desc: When a woman investigates a clamor on the roof of her rural house, she discovers a small UFO and little aliens emerging from it. Or so it seems.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Penny For Your Thoughts
programme.desc: Gaining telepathic abilities when his coin lands on its edge bank clerk Hector B. Poole learns about the difference between other people's plans and fantasies.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Twenty-Two
programme.desc: While in the hospital recovering from overwork, Liz Powell keeps dreaming about going down to the hospital morgue.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemi
programme.desc: South Park bliver 'Cloverfield', da store, mystiske skabninger begynder at lave ravage rundt om på jorden, indfanget af Randys rystende webcamera.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemi 2: Chokket
programme.desc: Kæmpemarsvin angriber byer rundt om på jorden. Drengene har nøglen til at redde menneskeheden, men de sidder fast i Andesbjergene

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion rejser sig
programme.desc: Ført an af 'Mysterion', arbejder 'Coon' og hans venner med at hjælpe folk i Golfen. Og 'Coon' er ude efter hævn.

programme.title: South Park: Coon vs. Coon og venner
programme.desc: 'The Coon' viser sig at være endnu ondere end den mørke mester Cthulhu, når han kræver hævn over sine tidligere partnere.

programme.title: South Park: Det fattige barn
programme.desc: Kennys forældre bliver anholdt og han kommer i pleje - så nu er Cartman det fattigste barn på skolen! Og en mystisk, maskeret figur fra fortiden vender tilbage.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Den nye dreng i klassen overtaler Jesus til at slås med hans far, Satan, i det endelige slag mellem det gode og det onde. Cartman bliver rasende over at høre, at sammenstødet falder sammen med hans fødselsdagsfest.

programme.title: South Park: Den uhyggelige fisk
programme.desc: Sharon Marshs tante Flo har gaver med til Shelly og Stan. Shelly får et fantastisk stereoanlæg, men Stans gave er en fisk; der er bare det ved det, at der er noget uhyggeligt over den fisk.

programme.title: South Park: Succubus
programme.desc: Cartman er hos optikeren, en mand der gør nar af hans vægtproblem ved at kalde ham 'Piggy'.

programme.title: South Park: Korns seje piratspøgelsemysterium
programme.desc: Drengene plages af dem fra 5.klasse, og South Park bliver løbet over ende af piratspøgelser i denne uhyggelige Halloween-episode.

programme.title: South Park: Wall-Mart er på vej
programme.desc: Da Wall-Mart forvandler South Park til en spøgelsesby, prøver Stan og Kyle at ødelægge forretningen, men en besat Cartman står dem i vejen.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Nathan For You: A Celebration
programme.desc: I dette særafsnit taler Nathan med tidligere gæster i serien, som f.eks. Brian Wolfe og spøgelsesmægleren.

programme.title: Nathan For You: The Richards Tip
programme.desc: Nathan hjælper en diner i en lille by med en ekstrem gavmild gerning.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Andy vs. Uber
programme.desc: Nathan går sammen med en taxichauffør om at vælte Uber.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Chili Shop / Massage Parlor
programme.desc: Nathan hjælper en chilibiks med at sælge mad til hockeyfans, og en massagesalon lærer at opsælge til sine kunder.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Shipping Logistics Company
programme.desc: Nathan lærer en international eksportør at sende røgalarmer skattefrit.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Computer Repair / Psychic
programme.desc: Nathan hjælper en butik, der reparerer computere, med at vinde folks tillid, og en synsk persons marketing bliver personlig.

programme.title: Nathan For You: The Anecdote
programme.desc: Nathan forbedrer sine evner som historiefortæller.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Finding Frances Part 1
programme.desc: I dette specialprogram på to timer forsøger Nathan at hjælpe en Bill Gates-imitator med at finde sin gamle kærlighed.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Finding Frances Part 2
programme.desc: I dette specialprogram på to timer forsøger Nathan at hjælpe en Bill Gates-imitator med at finde sin gamle kærlighed.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes And The Secret Weapon
programme.desc: Starting in Switzerland, Sherlock Holmes rescues the inventor of a bomb-sight which the allies want to keep from the Nazis. Back in London it seems that the inventor is not all that he seemed.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes Faces Death
programme.desc: During WWII, several murders occur at a convalescent home where Dr. Watson has volunteered his services. Holmes is summoned to solve the crime from a long list of suspects including the owners, staff, and the patients.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes Terror By Night
programme.desc: Holmes is hired by Roland Carstairs to prevent the theft of the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond owned by Carstairs' mother, Lady Margaret. Believing the diamond will be stolen on a train trip from London to Edinburgh.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes in Washington
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson travel to Washington D.C. in order to prevent a secret document from falling into enemy hands.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 9
programme.desc: Richard laver en G-Wiz elbil til et fjernstyret legetøj, James prøvekører en Jaguar XF-sedan, og David Tennant er dagens gæst.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 4
programme.desc: I et kapløb på tværs af Japan prøver Jeremy Clarkson at bevise, at en Nissan GT-R er hurtigere end landets ultraeffektive offentlige transportsystem.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 3
programme.desc: Teamet rejser tværs over USA og løser diverse udfordringer undervejs - i biler, der er købt for mindre end $1.000.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 6
programme.desc: Richard Hammond starter i den fjerneste del af Canada med at test et ur med indbygget nødsignal.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 4
programme.desc: Top Gear-gutterne forsøger at lave deres eget "tog" med en bil, der trækker en række campingvogne. Rowan Atkinson er stjernen i den prisbillige bil.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: En marinesoldat anklages for mord, men hævder selv, at han er uskyldig. Det er nu op til NCIS-holdet at vurdere, hvad der er sandt.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: En sag om smugling fører holdet til Mexico, hvor de skal forsøge at finde de farlige stoffer, der er forsvundet.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Efter at Sams mission i Sudan får en dødelig udgang, må Callen og NCIS-holdet forsøge at finde den forsvundne agent, før det er for sent.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Hetty bliver nødt til at give Deeks sparket og sender ham tilbage til LAPD. Kensi og Deeks tager afsked på en akavet måde, hvilket efterlader hende med uventede følelser over for sin gamle partner.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Sam bliver distraheret fra sit job som følge af en intensiv jagt efter den rette julegave til datteren. Holdet kæmper for at finde det udstyr, der blev stjålet fra en forskningsinstitution, og som er kraftfuldt nok til at ødelægge hele Los Angeles.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nell går undercover efter at en forsker ved forsvarsafdelingen bliver myrdet. Samtidig sætter den nye NCIS-direktørassistent spørgsmålstegn ved Hettys lederegenskaber.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Charisma Carpenter
programme.desc: Well-loved actress, Charisma Carpenter (Buffy the Vampire Slayer) returns to her childhood home in Las Vegas where she was terrorized by an unknown entity for years.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Eric Dickerson
programme.desc: NFL great, Eric Dickerson fears that there are spirits in his Calabasas, California home tormenting his children.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Kevin Sorbo
programme.desc: Legendary actor, Kevin Sorbo returns to an idyllic lake in Texas where he encountered a ghostly apparition so disturbing it haunts him to this day.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Tutbury Castle
programme.desc: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Ordsall Hall

programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Common Thread
programme.desc: After 10 bodies turn up in Florida, one victim — 17-year-old Lisa McVey — is abducted but released. She leads police to the perpertrator, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Killer Next Door
programme.desc: Two teenage girls are ambushed by a man wielding a baseball bat. He wants to party. The girls resist but, in the struggle, one girl is beaten and left in a coma and the other is raped and murdered, her body dumped in the nearby river.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Big Batch
programme.desc: After the dead body of a beautiful young woman is found in a stream, suspicion falls on a wannabe biker who was seen drinking with the victim the night before. But before police can make an arrest, they discover their prime suspect is destroying evidence.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Deadly Thrills
programme.desc: A gas station attendant is found dead. He has been shot twice and the gas station robbed. With no eyewitnesses, the police have a monumental task before them. The case reaches a dead end, until another shooting reveals a forensic connection.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Night of Rage
programme.desc: On Victoria Day as fireworks are going off, someone is on a killing spree. The next morning, three prostitutes are found dead. One transvestite; one transsexual and the third is a woman. The bullets from each killing prove to come from the same gun.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: When a young man goes missing and his wallet is found near Algonquin Park, his sister and mother call it murder, but without evidence, the police must deem him a “missing person.” But on the eve of his memorial service, police get a tip about his murder.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Master Mind
programme.desc: When a respected gallery owner suspects he is being scammed, he calls in the police. He has been sold a painting by a well-known artist that he fears is a fake. The trail to convict the master con-artist is a winding one and crosses international borders.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Predator
programme.desc: On a cool November evening, a young woman walks home from the bus stop through a local park. Suddenly, she is approached by a man. He politely asks her if she dropped any money. But before she can respond, he grabs her and drags her off the path.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Away
programme.desc: Ronald Dalton has an idyllic life – a loving marriage, three beautiful children and a solid career in banking. But in one night, all that is ripped away from him. His wife dies under unusual circumstances and the forensic pathologist says it is murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Special Tribute

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Jada Khaled kidnappes efter at være blevet offer for et baghold. Resten af holdet bliver straks tilkaldt med henblik på at redde hende og finde de skyldige.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Den nationale sikkerhed trues, og holdet skal afdække, hvad der gik galt, da en diplomatvarevogn blev kapret. Efter fem år som partnere, konfronteres Callen og Sam med deres hidtil største udfordring.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet er på jagt efter en international morder, som er i stand til at forvandle sig som en kamæleon for at undgå at blive fanget.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Kensi arresteres for mordet på sin fars tidligere kollega, og NCIS-holdet kæmper nu hårdt for at bevise hendes uskyld.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Holdet løber ind i problemer, da de forsøger at modbevise anklagerne mod Kensi Blye, der beskyldes for mord.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Ved deres highschool-genforening konkurrerer Finch og hans barndomsven over en pige, som de begge plejede at idolisere. Maya og Elliott beslutter sig for at blive venner med fordele.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Da Simon frier til Nina, bliver hun nødt til at afsløre, at hun allerede er gift. Jack finder den perfekte fyr til Maya, men hun bliver forelsket i en anden.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Mens Maya overbeviser Finchs kæreste om at kræve et mere emotionelt meningsfyldt forhold, konkurrerer Nina og Jack om rengøringspersonalets opmærksomhed på kontoret.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Alt imens Nina opdager en foruroligende sandhed om Simons ultrakonservative forældre, opdager Elliott, at det ikke er helt let at være Jacks nabo.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Den godhjertede Elliott diskuterer forretningsstrategier med sin svindler af en bror, Donnie.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Mens Finch forsøger at holde sin far i arbejde ved at få ham ansat som Jacks nye chauffør, erhverver Elliott en aldrende onkels hjælp til at hævne sig på en led komiker.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Mens Elliott forsøger at overbevise sin tidligere sognepræst om, at han stadig er en god katolik, kæmper Maya for at undgå en irriterende midaldrende praktikants opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Ninas bryllupsdag nærmer sig, men hendes planer begynder at gå i vasken, da præsten viser sig at være en af Simons tidligere groupies.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Jack overrasker alle ved at annoncere at han skal gå på pension.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Journalisten Maya har brug for penge og tvinges til at tage et job på et modemagasin, der ejes af hendes far.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: A small town veterinarian links an epidemic of tumors in humans to a new breed of genetically engineered corn.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: An engineer builds a robot and incorporates the memories of his son who died in a car accident twenty years earlier.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: In a world where resources are limited, each shift of workers is placed in stasis during their off hours. A man and woman from different shifts fall in love and try to circumvent the system.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Alien encounter buffs gather at a national convention where someone shows up with what appears to be a piece of an alien spaceship.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Anne Reynolds, estranged from her mother, haunted by her dead father and terrified of being close to anyone, is attacked, injured and wakes up on the operating table a changed woman.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Tom and Wendy are happy together. However, Tom has terrible memories. He is really an android that was used to save people in dangerous situations and then was upgraded to think for himself.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Irina Draga taler med Kenny Aleksandr om vejen fra reality-tv til influencer og iværksætter, om skønhed, moderskab og livet bag den polerede facade – og om at tage kontrollen over sin egen fortælling.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Lina Rafn er fyldt 50 og lægger ikke skjul på, at det kræver en indsats at se ud, som hun gør. Med Kenny Aleksandr taler hun om skønhed, alder, vilde X Factor-looks og om at stå ved den, man er – også når man forandrer sig.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Julie Zangenberg har levet det meste af sit liv i spotlightet. Nu har hun skruet ned for glansbilledet og op for sig selv. Om moderskab, venskabet med Medina, det smadrede blonde hår – og hvorfor hun er klar til både mere skuespil og mere glam.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Vickie Berlin taler med Kenny Aleksandr om at blive sat i bås som ”den sjove”, rollen i Triangle of Sadness, Cannes og Oscar – og om hvorfor man aldrig må holde op med at drømme og sætte nye ting på sin bucketliste.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Irina Draga taler med Kenny Aleksandr om vejen fra reality-tv til influencer og iværksætter, om skønhed, moderskab og livet bag den polerede facade – og om at tage kontrollen over sin egen fortælling.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: South Park: Cherokee hårtamponer

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Kommandør Riker bliver ramt af en dødbringende mikrobe, som invaderer hans centralnervesystem og angriber hjernen.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Af Helvedes Lys

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Workforce, Part 1

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Workforce, Part 2
programme.desc: To save Janeway and the rest of Voyager’s crew, Chakotay must convince her that her seemingly happy life as a worker on Quarra is not real.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Human Error
programme.desc: Seven’s attempt to explore her human side distracts her from her duties and puts Voyager at risk.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Q2
programme.desc: Q’s unruly and omnipotent son wreaks interstellar havoc when he is left in Janeway’s care.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Author, Author
programme.desc: The Doctor publishes a holo-novel based on his Voyager experiences which scandalizes the crew.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Disrobed
programme.desc: The crime scene was especially violent: a husband and wife had been shot to death in their bedroom. Was their 16-year-old daughter complicit?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shell Game
programme.desc: They thought the fire would cover their crime. But one tiny clue, no bigger than a thumbtack, remained. It held all the information investigators needed to put a trio of cold-blooded killers behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Van-ished
programme.desc: A twelve-year-old girl claimed she had been abducted and sexually assaulted. She recounted what happened in such a flat, unemotional voice that police found it difficult to believe her. Fibers on her clothing would prove she was telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Step by Step
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witness accounts contradicted evidence. To find out what really happened, investigators employed a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Within Arm's Reach
programme.desc: A police officer accused of killing his estranged wife insists she committed suicide. Investigators say it was murder — that it was physically impossible for the woman to have shot herself.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sharper Image
programme.desc: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odontologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Without a Prayer
programme.desc: In 1995, the founder of American Atheists disappeared with one of her sons, her granddaughter and $500,000 in gold coins. The police investigated several suspects, including David R. Waters, who worked for American Atheists.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Remorse
programme.desc: A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1987 the New Mexico Penitentiary housed hundreds of violent offenders, rapists, killers, men the juries put behind bars to protect society. On July fourth, seven of those men escaped.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programme.desc: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1980 the FBI faced the largest explosive device they had ever seen. The bomb was sophisticated, carefully constructed, and designed to destroy an entire building.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace
programme.desc: Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer: James Fairweather
programme.desc: James Fairweather is no ordinary teenager in 2014. Most his age don't choose the dark, violent games and websites that James does as he returns from school, retreats behind the bedroom door.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer: Mark Martin
programme.desc: Mark Martin made no secret of the fact that when he grew up he wanted to be a serial Killer. The Krays, Donald Neilson, Ian Brady all serial killers, were his childhood heroes.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer: Shawn Grate
programme.desc: Shawn was a good looking boy, and he learnt that he could turn on a smile and get what he wanted. He was popular with women but often in trouble for abusing them. He was sent to prison at 22 for choking his pregnant girlfriend.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer: Donna Perry
programme.desc: In Spokane three prostitutes were violently killed. Evidence suggested they'd been approached by a man wanting sex who had then used great strength to subdue and kill them. They had the suspects DNA, but detectives had no idea who the killer was.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Burning Obsession

programme.title: 72 Hours: Who Killed Santa?

programme.title: 72 Hours: Angel of Death

programme.title: On the Case: Scent of a Killer

programme.title: On the Case: Taken

programme.title: On the Case: Bound by the Truth

programme.title: Nathan For You: Clothing Store/ Restaurant
programme.desc: Nathan hjælper en uafhængig tankstation med at tilbyde verdens største rabat. Han prøver også at gøre en karikaturkunstner berømt.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Gas Station/Caricature Artist
programme.desc: Nathan afprøver en privatdetektiv ved at lade sig selv blive udspioneret en dag, et taxifirma får en løsning til generte kunder, og Nathan demonstrerer, hvordan man fyrer nogen.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Haunted House/ The Hunk
programme.desc: Nathan hjælper en bedemand, en burgerbiks er nødt til at holde fast i, at de har de bedste burgere i Los Angelas, og Nathan prøver skydiving.

programme.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson investigate the legend of a supernatural hound, a beast that may be stalking a young heir on the fog-shrouded moorland that makes up his estate.

programme.title: The Pearl of Death
programme.desc: When a valuable pearl with a sinister reputation is stolen, Sherlock Holmes must investigate its link to a series of brutal murders.

programme.title: The Scarlet Claw
programme.desc: When a gentlewoman is found dead with her throat torn out, the villagers blame a supernatural monster. But Sherlock Holmes, who gets drawn into the case from nearby Quebec, suspects a human murderer.

programme.title: The Spider Woman
programme.desc: In wartime Britain, Sherlock Holmes feigns death in order to investigate a spate of "pyjama suicides". His suspicions soon fall on the attractive but possibly deadly Andrea Spedding.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 7
programme.desc: Ford Transit har rund fødselsdag, og det fejres ved Nürburgring. Stjernen i den prisbillige bil er Justin Hawkins.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 4
programme.desc: Gutterne ser, om man kan købe en god italiensk superbil for under £10.000, og Dame Ellen MacArthur er stjernen i en prisbillig bil.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 3
programme.desc: Gutterne prøver at finde nye biler, der kan erstatte og forbedre en standardambulance, før de påtager sig en række udfordringer.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 8
programme.desc: De sidste to film fra den sidste serie. Jeremy, Richard og James kaster sig ud i livet som veteranbilsentusiaster.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Da en optagelse af en forbrydelse bliver lagt på nettet, tager NCIS-teamet til stranden for at efterforske, hvilken forbindelse en surfer og en videnskabsmand har til videoen.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: En pensioneret CIA-agent bliver dræbt, og teamet må spørge Hetty om hendes forhold til manden.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Teamet efterforsker et guldrøveri, som måske har forbindelse til terrorisme. Kensi er tvunget til at have Granger som makker, mens Deeks vidner i retten.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Callen, Sam, Kensi og Deeks er ude på havet for at efterforske en NCIS-agents død. Da Hetty beslutter sig for at tage på en rejse, må Eric og Nell tage styringen på hovedkvarteret.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet efterforsker en sag om bilshipping, og en kvinde fra Deeks fortid viser sig at være involveret. Som en del af efterforskningen arbejder Kensi under dække på et autoværksted.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Joan Rivers, David Carradine, Scott Baio, Teri Polo
programme.desc: Joan Rivers asks a voodoo priestess to help her with an angry ghost.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Barry Williams, Debi Mazar, Greg Grunberg, Sammy Hagar
programme.desc: When Barry Williams holds a memorial service for his father, a few strange "happenings" make the day even more unforgettable; Debi Mazer gets a hostile welcome from a ghost when she moves into a friend's home.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Carrie Fisher, Rue McClanahan, John Waters, Federico Castelluccio
programme.desc: Carrie Fisher has a spooky experience after her best friend dies in her bed; John Waters still remembers a scary night in the woods back in the 1950s.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tom Arnold, Dee Snider, Carnie Wilson, Nia Long
programme.desc: Tom Arnold takes his teenage anger out on a pipe organ, angering a revengeful spirit; Dee Snider's murdered brother-in-law has a message from the grave.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Kendra Wilkinson
programme.desc: Kendra Wilkinson (The Girls Next Door, Kendra on Top) is desperate to know what or who was behind the paranormal encounters she had at her former home in Pasadena, CA.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: Dark Star DA
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Maya og Finch tager til modeshow.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Slænget tænker tilbage på, da de mødte Jack for første gang.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Mayas mor kommer på besøg og bliver inddraget i en konflikt med Jack.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Maya aner uråd, da Nina foreslår en dobbeltdate.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Finch forsøger at hugge et bånd fra et overvågningskamera, hvor han og Jacks barnepige ses i en pinlig situation.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Jack narrer Maya til at få en nabo til at flytte ud - alt sammen for at han kan bygge et dampbad på sit arbejde.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Finch er overbevist om, at Nina har et fiktivt alter ego. Maya opdager, at Jack snød hende til Halloween for mange år siden.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Finch udfordrer Maya til at lave en klassisk practical joke.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Finch udtænker, hvordan han kan få Maya til at gå på date med en kvinde.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Elliott sværger hævn, da Finch bliver snydt af en kvinde.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Maya er overbevist om, at hendes nye kæreste sender hende beskeder på samme måde som dukkerne i hans tv-program for børn.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Colonel Beckett goes back in time to poison a physician who unintentionally spread a global pandemic. When the traveler returns to the future, nothing has changed.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: A couple flee a present-day religious community they've joined but find it's entirely surrounded by an invisible wall.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Claire Linkwood takes part in a surrogate mother program, unaware that it is a plot to invade and take over Earth.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: After a US Space Shuttle crash, one of the crew, a writer, miraculously survives. He now appears to be indestructible and has gifted insight.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Mona Lisa is a robotic assassin that develops a sense of humanity after the creators disengage her fail safe devices. She proceeds to find out more about earth and its inhabitants.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Vickie Berlin taler med Kenny Aleksandr om at blive sat i bås som ”den sjove”, rollen i Triangle of Sadness, Cannes og Oscar – og om hvorfor man aldrig må holde op med at drømme og sætte nye ting på sin bucketliste.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Irina Draga taler med Kenny Aleksandr om vejen fra reality-tv til influencer og iværksætter, om skønhed, moderskab og livet bag den polerede facade – og om at tage kontrollen over sin egen fortælling.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
